notes.title: Patch Update - 0.1.38.8b
notes.notes: [h3][b]Cosmic Patch: The MIX Fall Game Showcase Edition![/b][/h3][p][b]This update brings the Online multiplayer lobbies and now it's time to race with your friends.[/b] [/p][p]We've also been hard at work to bring you this update filled with improvements and fixes. Here’s a summary of what's new in the latest Cosmic Patch! 🚀[/p][h3][b]Driving and Gameplay[/b] 🏎️[/h3][list][*][p][b]Improved Car Handling:[/b] We've refined the car mechanics for better handling and collision response. This means your car will feel more predictable and stable, especially after hitting a wall or hitting a ramp and landing on its nose.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enhanced Car Effects:[/b] When your wheels hit the ground, you'll now see corresponding dust effects. We also improved the visual feedback of car collisions by increasing the number of collision points for sparks. ✨[/p][/*][*][p][b]Car Flipping Feedback:[/b] An upside-down detection system has been added to the car controller. If your car flips, a new UI panel will appear to provide feedback, including how to reset the car.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Better AI Behavior:[/b] AI opponents are now more dynamic. Their risk-taking and attack focus will change based on their position in the race. For example, AIs that are behind will take more risks, while those in the lead will be more cautious. We also fixed a bug that could cause the AI to target itself.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Performance and Stability[/b] ⚙️[/h3][list][*][p][b]Smoother Performance:[/b] We've made significant optimizations to reduce stutters and improve overall performance. This includes:[/p][list][*][p]Implementing a new object pooling system for things like runtime streaming and particle effects, which helps make the game run smoother and use less memory.[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaks to the AI and dynamic leaderboard tracking to give you better framerates and a more stable game.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Faster Loading:[/b] We've enabled background loading for audio to improve game performance when loading into a scene. 🎧[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]UI and Visuals[/b] 🎨[/h3][list][*][p][b]Interface and Readability:[/b] The in-game information panel now scales better on different screens. We also fixed anchor positions for UI elements to improve visibility.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Camera Adjustments:[/b] We've increased the camera's far clip plane to help you see distant objects more clearly. The field of view has also been adjusted for a better perspective. Additionally, camera shake values have been improved for interactions with walls and other obstacles.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Updated Car Selection:[/b] The car selection in garage now displays the car's name and has better visual feedback.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Smoother Multiplayer Experience:[/b] We've ironed out a bug that made other players' cars look a bit wonky. Now, their wheels will always be in the right place, not floating or stuck in the ground, for a much cleaner visual experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b] We've fixed a number of UI navigation issues, particularly for controller support. We also addressed layout inconsistencies in the FTUE (First-Time User Experience) scene. 👾[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Thank You ❤️[/b][/h3][p]We want to give a massive thank you to everyone who played the demo during the Steam Racing Fest! Your feedback and suggestions were incredibly valuable. This patch is a direct result of your input, and we've worked hard to address the most important points you raised.[/p][p]We hope you enjoy this update. Please continue to share your thoughts and talk with the developers directly on our Discord server. See you on the track! 👋[/p][p]— Cosmic Race Team (Psypher Interactive)[/p]

notes.title: Patch Update - 0.1.38.7e
notes.notes:
[h3][b]What’s new[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Quick Race (Single Player)
[/b]You can now dive into a local multiplayer session with a single click bots included, no setup required. Speed over ceremony.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Better Bot Awareness
[/b]The result screen now ignores AI when counting players. Because bots don’t wait politely—why should you?[/p][/*][*][p][b]Car Respawn Rework
[/b]We’ve completely overhauled the car respawn system with a new system. It’s smarter, faster, and more respectful of personal space (i.e., no more spawning on top of each other).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Button Smash Fix
[/b]Menu buttons now chill out after you press them—cooldowns have been added to prevent accidental double-pressing in the heat of a race.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Camera & UI[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed camera FOV for 4:3 aspect ratio.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted intro cam angles.[/p][/*][*][p]UI layout fixes for widescreens.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Settings & Performance[/b][/p][list][*][p]UI now only shows width x height (bye refresh rates).[/p][/*][*][p]SSAO toggle actually does something now.[/p][/*][*][p]Anti-aliasing properly applies 8x MSAA.[/p][/*][*][p]Shadow settings revamped to use URP’s realtime properties.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Audio[/b][/p][list][*][p]Bounce sounds no longer ignore master volume.[/p][/*][*][p]Button sounds moved to the proper SFX group.[/p][/*][*][p]Crowd noise fixed on Sedna track.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Scene Transitions[/b][/p][list][*][p]Client readiness tracking during scene load—less waiting, fewer bugs.[/p][/*][*][p]The game no longer stalls if the host disappears during car selection.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]🐞 Fixed car explosion on launchpad.[/p][/*][*][p]🐞 Fixed rematch buttons not enabling when bots are still racing.[/p][/*][*][p]🐞 Fixed chat messages duplicating across server/clients.[/p][/*][*][p]🐞 Fixed “waiting for players” logic to count only real humans.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]This update is part of our Steam Racing Fest release, and it’s been a wild ride![/p][p]Thank you for playing, racing, and occasionally exploding with us.[/p][p]As always, send feedback our way—especially if something feels off (or too on).[/p][p]🏁 See you at the starting line.[/p][p]— Cosmic Race Team (Psypher Interactive)[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Dev Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch Notes Update – Bug Fixes & Future Content Tease![/h1]

Greetings, Cosmic Racers!  

We’ve been hard at work making your galactic racing experience smoother and more exhilarating. Here are the latest fixes we've implemented on the demo:  

[list]
[*] [b]UI Prompts for Input:[/b] Previously, some prompts were playing hide-and-seek. We've tracked them down, and they're back where they belong.  
[*] [b]Intro Camera Sequence:[/b] Before each race, the camera decided to play its own game. That’s now fixed, and you can enjoy the immersive race intros as intended.  
[/list]

[h3]A Big Thank You! [/h3]
We want to extend our heartfelt gratitude to all our amazing players who tested the demo and provided invaluable feedback. Your input helps us make [b]Cosmic Race: Galactic Showdown[/b] the best it can be!  

Stay tuned, racers—there's more in the pipeline! We’re thrilled to reveal that exciting new content and features are heading your way. Keep your engines revved and your eyes on the stars!  

With galactic gratitude,  
The [b]Cosmic Race[/b] Dev Team 🌌🚀  
Psypher Interactive

notes.title: April 2025 - Dev Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Exciting News from Psypher Interactive: Cosmic Race: Galactic Showdown Update![/h1]    
Greetings, racers! 🚀
    
We’re thrilled to share some major updates about [u]Cosmic Race: Galactic Showdown[/u]. Your ongoing support has fueled our journey, and we’re taking our next big leap together.
   
 [h2]Indie Game Utsav Participation[/h2]    
[u]Cosmic Race: Galactic Showdown[/u] is part of the [b]Indie Game Utsav[/b], a Steam event that celebrates Indian indie game brilliance! But that’s not all—we’re also bringing the cosmic race to [b]Comic Con Mumbai 2025[/b], so come meet us in person and experience the thrill firsthand.
   
 [h2]Demo Released[/h2]    
Our game demo is now live on Steam and ready for you to explore the galaxies. And if you're attending [b]Comic Con Mumbai 2025[/b], don’t miss out on the exclusive chance to try the demo at our booth!
   
 [h2]Optimizations Inspired by You[/h2]    
Your feedback has been invaluable in shaping the game. We’ve worked hard to:
[list]
[*] Optimize gameplay for smoother performance,
[*] Address network lag issues, and
[*] Make [u]Cosmic Race: Galactic Showdown[/u] visually stunning like never before.
[/list]
Your insights continue to guide us, and we couldn’t be more grateful!
    
[h2]Join the Conversation on Discord[/h2]    
We’ve just launched a [url=https://discord.gg/9VSh7Ksfa3][b]Discord channel[/b][/url] for [u]Cosmic Race: Galactic Showdown[/u]! It’s the perfect place to connect, share feedback, and discuss strategies with fellow racers. [url=https://discord.gg/9VSh7Ksfa3]Join us today[/url]
    
Stay tuned for more updates, and don’t forget to grab the demo or visit us at [b]Comic Con Mumbai 2025[/b]. Let’s race through the stars together!

Finally, a heartfelt [b]thank you[/b] from the entire Psypher Interactive team. Your enthusiasm, feedback, and love for [u]Cosmic Race: Galactic Showdown[/u] inspire us every day. 🌟

-Psypher Interactive Team
